note: A named block disabled to break out of a loop - the first-set-bit scan, so the result depends on the loop stopping at the first set bit. Found hif-backend#85, which dropped the named block and its `disable`: the regenerated loop ran to completion and reported the last set bit (seven for d = 8'b1001_0110, where the source says one). Behavioral because the regenerated file is valid Verilog that reparses cleanly; only the answer differs. While hif-backend#80 stood in the way the failure was recorded at the reparse, which hid this.
